raw_response: DESCRIPTION: This grouped bar chart illustrates the "effect" values across nine language family categories for six different model configurations. The horizontal axis is labeled "family" and contains the categories IE-Baltic, IE-Germanic, IE-Indic, IE-Romance, IE-Slavic, IE-other, Isolate, Semitic, and Uralic, arranged from left to right. The vertical axis is labeled "effect" and uses a linear scale ranging from approximately -5 to 30, with tick marks at 0, 10, 20, and 30. Each language family group contains six bars corresponding to six model variants shown in the legend: mBERT-L₂ (light blue), XLM-L₂ (dark blue), mBERT-R₂ (light green), XLM-R₂ (dark green), mBERT-B₂ (light pink/salmon), and XLM-B₂ (red). All bars include error bars indicating variability. The tallest bars appear in the IE-Indic group, where mBERT-B₂ reaches approximately 24 and XLM-B₂ approximately 21, with mBERT-R₂ and XLM-R₂ also reaching around 18–21. IE-Germanic shows moderate values with XLM-B₂ at approximately 15 and mBERT-L₂ and XLM-L₂ near 10. IE-Slavic displays values up to approximately 17 for XLM-B₂. The Isolate category shows the smallest effect values, with bars very close to zero. The Semitic group shows mBERT-L₂ at approximately 11 and XLM-B₂ near 20, while mBERT-R₂ and XLM-R₂ appear slightly negative. The Uralic group similarly shows near-zero or slightly negative values for most models except XLM-B₂ at approximately 19. Across most families, the B₂ variants (pink and red) tend to display the tallest bars, while the L₂ variants (light and dark blue) generally show shorter bars. The error bars are notably large for several categories, particularly Semitic and Uralic, indicating substantial uncertainty in those estimates.
